title.zh: 10月6日00:11 UTC再核：伤亡口径未改
title.en: 6 Oct 00:11 UTC recheck: casualty figures unchanged

body.zh: 本轮再核新华社、指挥部、gov.cn、@XHNews、@CCTV_Plus：中方仍为截至9月5日18时，43死、519失联、救出2人。应急管理部9月17日合计562人死亡失踪、仍在核查，不替代分项。PTI/IANS引10月5日NDRRMA仍写1455死、5285失踪、13795获救，不替代epardafas周一5时遗体1457、失踪4718。获救仍用NDRRMA 9月26日13795。堰塞湖仍为新华社9月5日已排空。G216仍为交通厅9月28日双向管制。美使馆道路告示仍为9月3日。无新UNOSAT/Copernicus EMS激活。无新队伍坐标。
body.en: Recheck of Xinhua, command text, gov.cn, @XHNews and @CCTV_Plus: CN remains as of 5 Sep 18:00, 43 dead, 519 missing, 2 rescued. MEM 17 Sep combined 562 dead and missing, still under verification, does not replace the split. PTI/IANS citing NDRRMA on 5 Oct still write 1455 dead, 5285 missing and 13795 rescued, so they do not replace the epardafas Monday 05:00 count of 1457 bodies and 4718 missing. Rescued stays the NDRRMA 26 Sep figure 13795. Barrier lake remains Xinhua 5 Sep drained. G216 remains 28 Sep two-way control. US Embassy road notice remains 3 Sep. No new UNOSAT/Copernicus EMS activation. No new team coordinates.
body.ne: Xinhua/command/gov.cn/@XHNews/@CCTV_Plus: CN 5 Sep 18:00 43/519/2. MEM 17 Sep 562 jod, verify baki. PTI/IANS/NDRRMA 5 Oct 1455/5285/13795 purano ank, epardafas sombar 05:00 1457/4718 badaldaina. Uddar 26 Sep 13795. Tal Xinhua 5 Sep khali. G216 28 Sep niyantran. US Embassy 3 Sep. Naya UNOSAT/Copernicus EMS chaina. GNSS chaina.
body.hi: Xinhua/command/gov.cn/@XHNews/@CCTV_Plus: CN 5 Sep 18:00 43/519/2. MEM 17 Sep 562 jod, verification baaki. PTI/IANS/NDRRMA 5 Oct 1455/5285/13795 purane ank, epardafas somvar 05:00 1457/4718 nahi badalte. Uddhar 26 Sep 13795. Jheel Xinhua 5 Sep khali. G216 28 Sep niyantran. US Embassy 3 Sep. Naya UNOSAT/Copernicus EMS nahi. GNSS nahi.

title.en: epardafas 5 Oct: 1457 bodies, 4718 missing as of Monday 05:00

body.zh: epardafas：截至周一5时寻获1457具遗体，拉苏瓦236、Nuwakot 205、Dhading 73、Chitwan 369、Gorkha 80、Tanahun 38、Nawalparasi East 232、West 222，加德满都治疗中死亡2人。仍寻4718名失踪。安置点1226人。DNA：遗体1336、亲属2077。警力7975人。未更新获救数。无新队伍坐标。
body.en: epardafas: 1457 bodies as of Monday 05:00 — Rasuwa 236, Nuwakot 205, Dhading 73, Chitwan 369, Gorkha 80, Tanahun 38, Nawalparasi East 232, West 222, plus 2 deaths in Kathmandu treatment. Search continues for 4718 missing. 1226 in holding centres. DNA: 1336 deceased, 2077 relatives. 7975 police. Rescued not updated. No new team coordinates.
body.ne: epardafas: sombar 05:00 1457 sharir, 4718 harayeka, holding 1226. Rasuwa 236. DNA mritak 1336, natidar 2077. Police 7975. Uddar update chaina. GNSS chaina.
body.hi: epardafas: somvar 05:00 1457 sharir, 4718 lapata, holding 1226. Rasuwa 236. DNA mritak 1336, rishte 2077. Police 7975. Uddhar update nahi. GNSS nahi.

title.zh: 10月5日：国家减灾理事会结束大规模搜救，转向重建
title.en: 5 Oct: national council ends mass SAR, shifts to reconstruction
title.ne: 5 Oct: rastriya parishad le thulo khoj rokeko, punarnirman tira
title.hi: 5 Oct: rashtriya parishad ne bada khoj roka, punarnirman ki or

body.zh: PTI：总理沙阿主持第21次国家减灾理事会，决定除必要行动外结束40天搜救，转向博特科西—特里舒里重建，并建议约559.17亿卢比、504项计划。所引NDRRMA为1455死、5285失踪、13795获救。无新队伍坐标。
body.en: PTI: PM Shah chaired the 21st national DRR council and decided to end the 40-day search except essential work, shifting to Bhotekoshi-Trishuli reconstruction, and recommended about NPR 559.17 billion for 504 plans. Cited NDRRMA: 1455 dead, 5285 missing, 13795 rescued. No new team coordinates.
body.ne: PTI: PM Shah ko 21st council le 40-din khoj rokeko, avashyak bahyek. NPR 559.17 arba. NDRRMA 1455/5285/13795. GNSS chaina.
body.hi: PTI: PM Shah ki 21st council ne 40-din khoj roka, zaroori chhodkar. NPR 559.17 arb. NDRRMA 1455/5285/13795. GNSS nahi.

title.zh: 央视10月4日：中尼科考队从成都启程赴尼
title.en: CCTV 4 Oct: China-Nepal science team left Chengdu for Nepal
title.ne: CCTV 4 Oct: science team Chengdu bata Nepal tira
title.hi: CCTV 4 Oct: science team Chengdu se Nepal ke liye

body.zh: 央视/香港01：喜马拉雅8·26应急跨境科考队50余人10月4日从成都启程赴尼，溯源冰岩崩并服务吉隆口岸重建。文中引应急管理部9月17日口径为562人死亡失踪、仍在核查，不替代9月5日分项。无现场坐标。
body.en: CCTV/HK01: 50-plus researchers of the Himalaya 26 Aug emergency team left Chengdu for Nepal on 4 Oct to trace the ice-rock avalanche and support Gyirong Port reconstruction. The text cites MEM 17 Sep as 562 dead and missing at the port, still being verified, and does not replace the 5 Sep split figures. No field coordinates.
body.ne: CCTV/HK01: 50+ scientist 4 Oct Chengdu bata Nepal tira. MEM 17 Sep 562 mrit/samparka bihin, verify baki. 5 Sep ank badaldaina. GNSS chaina.
body.hi: CCTV/HK01: 50+ scientist 4 Oct Chengdu se Nepal ke liye. MEM 17 Sep 562 mrit/lapata, verification baaki. 5 Sep ank nahi badalte. GNSS nahi.

title.zh: 交通厅9月28日：G216吉隆镇—国门仍双向管制
title.en: Transport dept 28 Sep: G216 town-gate still controlled
title.ne: Transport 28 Sep: G216 dui tira niyantran
title.hi: Transport 28 Sep: G216 dono disha niyantran

body.zh: 西藏自治区交通运输厅路网：G216 K3500+200（吉隆镇）—K3525+850（吉隆国门）自8月26日起双向交通管制，解除时间待定。本轮无更新。
body.en: Xizang transport: G216 K3500+200 (Gyirong town) to K3525+850 (gate) remains two-way controlled since 26 Aug; lift time unset. No update this cycle.
body.ne: Xizang transport: G216 K3500+200-K3525+850 26 Aug dekhi dui tira niyantran. Yo cycle update chaina.
body.hi: Xizang transport: G216 K3500+200-K3525+850 26 Aug se dono disha niyantran. Is cycle update nahi.

body.zh: PTI引NDRRMA 9月26日：1453死、5285失踪、13795获救。死亡与失踪已被更新口径替代；KPI获救仍用此数，因本轮无更新。
body.en: PTI cites NDRRMA 26 Sep: 1453 dead, 5285 missing, 13795 rescued. Dead and missing superseded; KPI rescued stays at 13795 because this cycle has no newer rescued figure.
body.ne: PTI/NDRRMA 26 Sep: uddar 13795. Mrit/harayeka naya le badleko. Uddar naya chaina.
body.hi: PTI/NDRRMA 26 Sep: uddhar 13795. Mrit/lapata naya se badle. Uddhar naya nahi.

title.zh: 指挥部9月6日：截至9月5日18时 43死519失联
title.en: Command 6 Sep: as of 5 Sep 18:00, 43 dead, 519 missing
title.ne: Command 6 Sep: 5 Sep 18:00, 43 mrit, 519 samparka bihin

body.zh: 人民日报/中国西藏网引吉隆应急救援指挥部：截至9月5日18时，43人遇难、519人失联、成功救出2人、遗物993件。外籍失联261人、23国。此后新华社与@XHNews未见更新分项伤亡。
body.en: People's Daily and tibet.cn cite the Gyirong command: as of 5 Sep 18:00, 43 dead, 519 missing, 2 rescued, 993 personal effects. 261 missing foreigners from 23 countries. No later split casualty update from Xinhua or @XHNews.
body.ne: Command: 5 Sep 18:00 43 mrit, 519 samparka bihin, 2 uddar. Bideshi 261. Xinhua pachi naya split casualty chaina.
body.hi: Command: 5 Sep 18:00 43 mrit, 519 lapata, 2 uddhar. Videshi 261. Xinhua ke baad naya split casualty nahi.

title.zh: 新华社9月5日：口岸上方堰塞湖已排空
title.en: Xinhua 5 Sep: barrier lake above the port drained
title.ne: Xinhua 5 Sep: port mathi ko bandha tal khali
title.hi: Xinhua 5 Sep: port ke upar ka barrier lake khali

body.zh: 新华社引应急管理部门：口岸核心区上方堰塞湖已排空，河道恢复过流，险情基本解除。本轮无新堰塞湖通报。
body.en: Xinhua cites emergency management: lake above the port core has drained, the channel is flowing, and the hazard is largely eliminated. No later barrier-lake bulletin.
body.ne: Xinhua: tal khali, nadi sadharan, jokhim hatyo. Pachi naya tal bulletin chaina.
body.hi: Xinhua: jheel khali, nadi normal, khatra hat gaya. Baad mein naya jheel bulletin nahi.

title.zh: 美国驻尼使馆9月3日：勿前往Rasuwagadhi-Timure
title.en: US Embassy Nepal 3 Sep: do not travel Rasuwagadhi-Timure
title.hi: US Embassy 3 Sep: Rasuwagadhi-Timure mat jao

body.zh: 使馆道路告示仍为9月3日：勿前往Rasuwagadhi-Timure-Syafrubesi。本轮未见更新告示。
body.en: Embassy road notice remains 3 Sep: do not travel to Rasuwagadhi-Timure-Syafrubesi. No newer notice found.
body.ne: Embassy notice 3 Sep nai: Rasuwagadhi-Timure-Syafrubesi najau. Naya notice chaina.
body.hi: Embassy notice 3 Sep hi: Rasuwagadhi-Timure-Syafrubesi mat jao. Naya notice nahi.

detail.zh: 口岸设施已毁，通关未恢复。中方关闭。本轮无重开通报。
detail.en: Port facilities destroyed; clearance not restored. Chinese side closed. No reopening notice this cycle.
detail.ne: Port dhvasta; clearance khuleko chaina. Chiniya taraf band. Yo cycle khulne notice chaina.
detail.hi: Port dhvast; clearance nahi. Chini taraf band. Is cycle khulne ka notice nahi.

detail.zh: 交通厅9月28日路网：K3500+200—K3525+850双向管制，解除时间待定。抢险通道仅救援。
detail.en: Transport bulletin 28 Sep: K3500+200-K3525+850 two-way control, lift time unset. Rescue track only.
detail.ne: 28 Sep road info: K3500+200-K3525+850 dui tira niyantran. Rescue bato matra.
detail.hi: 28 Sep road info: K3500+200-K3525+850 dono disha niyantran. Rescue path hi.

detail.zh: 美国驻尼使馆9月3日：正常通行未恢复，勿前往。本轮无新告示。
detail.en: US Embassy Nepal 3 Sep: normal access not restored; do not travel. No newer notice.
detail.ne: US Embassy 3 Sep: sadharan bato chaina; najau. Naya notice chaina.
detail.hi: US Embassy 3 Sep: normal rasta nahi; mat jao. Naya notice nahi.

detail.zh: 截至9月5日18时：2500余人，核心区搜寻与消杀已覆盖。无新现场坐标。
detail.en: As of 5 Sep 18:00: 2500+ personnel; core search and disinfection covered. No new live GNSS.
detail.ne: 5 Sep 18:00: 2500+ jana; core khoj cover. Naya GNSS chaina.
detail.hi: 5 Sep 18:00: 2500+ log; core khoj cover. Naya GNSS nahi.

detail.zh: 10月5日国家减灾理事会：除必要行动外结束大规模搜救。epardafas周一5时仍列7975名警员。无新队伍坐标，故不标经纬度。
detail.en: 5 Oct national council: mass SAR ended except essential work. epardafas Monday 05:00 still lists 7975 police. No new team GNSS, so no lat/lng.
detail.ne: 5 Oct council: thulo khoj rokeko. epardafas: police 7975. Toli GNSS chaina.
detail.hi: 5 Oct council: bada khoj roka. epardafas: police 7975. Team GNSS nahi.

detail.zh: 10月4日50余人从成都启程赴尼溯源，非现场救援坐标，不标经纬度。
detail.en: On 4 Oct, 50-plus researchers left Chengdu for Nepal to trace the source. Not a field rescue fix, so no lat/lng.
detail.ne: 4 Oct 50+ scientist Chengdu bata Nepal tira. Field GNSS chaina.
detail.hi: 4 Oct 50+ scientist Chengdu se Nepal ke liye. Field GNSS nahi.

detail.zh: 9月5日指挥部：核心区搜寻与预防性消杀已全覆盖。救出2人。
detail.en: 5 Sep command: core-area search and preventive disinfection fully covered. 2 rescued.
detail.ne: 5 Sep command: core khoj ra disinfection cover. 2 uddar.
detail.hi: 5 Sep command: core khoj aur disinfection cover. 2 uddhar.

detail.zh: 新华社9月9日：已返回444人，另有55人准备返回。本轮无新安置数。
detail.en: Xinhua 9 Sep: 444 evacuated residents returned; another 55 preparing to return. No new shelter count this cycle.
detail.ne: Xinhua 9 Sep: 444 pharkeka; arko 55 tayar. Naya shelter ank chaina.
detail.hi: Xinhua 9 Sep: 444 wapas; 55 aur taiyar. Naya shelter ank nahi.

detail.zh: 尼方10月5日除必要行动外结束大规模搜救。口岸与友谊桥仍毁，通行未恢复。
detail.en: Nepal ended mass SAR on 5 Oct except essential work. Port and friendship bridge remain destroyed; access not restored.
detail.ne: Nepal le 5 Oct thulo khoj rokeko. Port ra bridge dhvasta; bato chaina.
detail.hi: Nepal ne 5 Oct bada khoj roka. Port aur bridge dhvast; rasta nahi.

status.zh: 新华社9月5日：口岸上方堰塞湖已排空，河道恢复过流，险情基本解除。本轮无新通报。
status.en: Xinhua 5 Sep: barrier lake above the port drained, channel flowing, hazard largely eliminated. No new bulletin this cycle.
status.ne: Xinhua 5 Sep: bandha tal khali, nadi sadharan, jokhim hatyo. Yo cycle naya bulletin chaina.
status.hi: Xinhua 5 Sep: barrier lake khali, nadi normal, khatra hat gaya. Is cycle naya bulletin nahi.

text.zh: @XHNews 9月10日：国家气候中心正向尼泊尔提供滚动气候监测与预报，支持吉隆—拉苏瓦口岸泥石流救援。无新伤亡数。
text.en: @XHNews 10 Sep: National Climate Center is sending rolling climate monitoring and forecasts to Nepal for Gyirong-Rasuwa rescue. No new casualty figures.
text.ne: @XHNews 10 Sep: climate center le Nepal lai forecast pathairacha. Naya casualty chaina.
text.hi: @XHNews 10 Sep: climate center Nepal ko forecast de raha hai. Naya casualty nahi.

text.zh: @CCTV_Plus 9月10日：部分尼泊尔务工人员仍留在吉隆镇并恢复工作。无新伤亡数，不标识可识别受害人。
text.en: @CCTV_Plus 10 Sep: some Nepali workers remain in Gyirong Town and have resumed work. No new casualty figures; no identifiable victims.
text.ne: @CCTV_Plus 10 Sep: kehi Nepali karmi Gyirong Town ma kaam garira. Naya casualty chaina.
text.hi: @CCTV_Plus 10 Sep: kuchh Nepali karmchari Gyirong Town mein kaam par. Naya casualty nahi.

text.zh: @XHNews 9月9日：回顾8月26日冰岩崩触发泥石流冲击吉隆口岸，中方已全力搜救。该帖未给出新的分项伤亡。
text.en: @XHNews 9 Sep: recap of the 26 Aug ice-rock avalanche mudslide at Gyirong Port and the Chinese search. The post does not give a new split casualty count.
text.ne: @XHNews 9 Sep: 26 Aug Gyirong Port mudslide recap. Naya split casualty chaina.
text.hi: @XHNews 9 Sep: 26 Aug Gyirong Port mudslide recap. Naya split casualty nahi.
